meta.title: Spring Boneアニメーション処理の最適化
meta.body_summary: Optimize Spring Bone animation processing in Blender addon via pose bone caching, armature filtering, and matrix operation reuse, backed by before/after cProfile statistics.

core_change_summary.description: In handler.py, updated Spring Bone animation functions to cache pose bone rotation results, filter armature objects upfront, reduce redundant get_bone_name calls, and optimize matrix operations by caching transformations and reusing objects.
